verdict.rationale: LegalZoom's registered agent service (docs-13, docs-14, docs-31) confirms it acts as registered agent, alerts founders when official mail arrives, and stores documents in unlimited cloud storage — covering the core of receiving and digitizing legal mail. However, the evidence never explicitly mentions 'service of process' handling or scanned document delivery mechanics, and no independent/hands-on account corroborates the mail-alert workflow. Missing for 10: explicit service-of-process language, description of the scan/upload process, and third-party verification of reliability.
